title: Audit event batch
description: The body of POST /api/v1/events (docs/protocol; package audit, Batch). Beyond this schema: the body is at most 4 MiB, each event at most 65536 bytes, and hostname and version at most 255 bytes of valid UTF-8; no object has the same key twice (even in different case), and the batch nests at most 32 levels around its events (audit.CheckKeys).

id.description: The endpoint's identity, a lowercase UUID.

events.description: Audit lines as written; an empty list is a heartbeat.
